dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: An execution package for an m-by-n real matrix A and a stochastic model. Its constructor records n <= m, 0 < n, Householder vectors, local perturbation matrices, intermediate states, the final computed matrix RHat, output-operation indices, and the stated recurrence and structural properties.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The universally quantified run supplies the computed m-by-n matrix RHat used in every eventwise conclusion and implicitly imposes the execution package's dimension, recurrence, computed-value, and upper-trapezoidal conditions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of an execution package returning RHat : Omega -> Fin m -> Fin n -> Real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the random computed matrix appearing in the upper-trapezoidal assertion and in the exact factorization A + DeltaA = Q RHat.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: A local-control package for run, c5, and lambda. Its constructor supplies a measurable probability-one event whose membership is equivalent to every local perturbation having Euclidean operator bound c5 times exp((lambda sqrt(m) u + m u^2)/(1-u)) - 1, where u is the model's unit roundoff.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target assumes such a package as hlocal. It is required by the columnwise package but contributes no separately stated numerical term to the final conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: A stochastic arithmetic-model package containing a probability measure, an operation count, exact values, computed values, relative errors, and a unit roundoff. Its constructor requires total mass one, 0 <= u < 1, computedValue = exactValue*(1+error), absolute error at most u, measurability, integrability, zero means, and the supplied previous-error factorization property.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The model supplies the probability measure used for the good-event bound and the unit roundoff used in the perturbation coefficient and remainder evaluation. Its internal assumptions make that measure finite and constrain u.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of a stochastic model returning its measure on Omega.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the probability measure whose real-valued mass of the existential good event is bounded below.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of a stochastic model returning its real unit roundoff u.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The final coefficient is evaluated at u, and the normwise remainder is evaluated at the same u.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: A columnwise backward-error package. Its constructor provides a measurable good event with probability at least 1-2mn exp(-lambda^2), random Q and DeltaA, and per-column remainders O(u^2), such that on the event Q^T Q = I, A+DeltaA=Q RHat, and each column perturbation obeys the stated Euclidean bound.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target assumes this package and concludes a corresponding Frobenius-norm perturbation bound with one pointwise normwise O(u^2) remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a real m-by-n matrix B, sqrt(sum_i sum_j B_ij^2), the Frobenius norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures A and DeltaA in the final normwise perturbation inequality.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m-by-m real matrix Q, the condition that for all i,j, sum_k Q_ki Q_kj equals 1 when i=j and 0 otherwise; equivalently Q^T Q = I_m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires Q(omega) to have orthonormal columns for every omega in the good event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number 1 - 2mn exp(-lambda^2), with m and n cast to reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the exact lower bound on the real-valued probability of the good event.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: For unit roundoff u, the coefficient c6*lambda*sqrt(n)*(exp((lambda*sqrt(m)*u + m*u^2)/(1-u)) - 1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Multiplying the Frobenius norm of A, it forms the leading term in the final bound for the Frobenius norm of DeltaA.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary matrix multiplication: (QR)_ij = sum_k Q_ik R_kj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the exact eventwise equality A + DeltaA(omega) = Q(omega) RHat(omega).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: The assertion that a real function remainder(u) is O(u^2) as u tends to 0 through the real neighborhood filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For each fixed omega, the existential normwise remainder as a function of u must be O(u^2). The assertion is pointwise in omega.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: An m-by-n matrix R is upper trapezoidal: R_ij = 0 whenever the column index j is strictly less than the row index i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: RHat(omega) must satisfy this condition for every omega in the good event; the input execution package in fact already records it for every omega.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for an execution package. It requires n <= m and 0 < n; vectors v_j with sum_i v_ji^2=2; states X_0=A and X_{j+1}=(I-v_j v_j^T+E_j)X_j; RHat=X_n; every RHat entry to equal a model computed value; and RHat to be upper trapezoidal.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Because run is an input of the constructed type, these conditions are implicit hypotheses. They constrain dimensions and identify the RHat used in the conclusion as the computed final state.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for the local-control package. It records a measurable event of measure exactly one, characterized by simultaneous bounds ||E_j x||_2 <= c5*gamma_m(lambda,u)*||x||_2 for every column j and vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It explains the semantic content of the assumed hlocal object on which the columnwise hypothesis depends.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for the stochastic model, with a probability measure, operation-indexed exact/computed/error values, relative-error equation, uniform absolute error bound u, measurable integrable zero-mean errors, and factorization against functions of earlier errors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It ensures that model.probability is a probability measure and that model.unitRoundoff satisfies 0 <= u < 1, while linking run outputs to modeled computed values.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: The constructor for the columnwise package. It records a measurable event with the target probability threshold, Q, DeltaA, per-column O(u^2) remainders, eventwise orthogonality and exact factorization, and column bounds using c6*lambda*sqrt(n)*gamma_m(lambda,u).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This structured assumption is the direct source of the existential good event and backward factorization that the target upgrades from columnwise Euclidean bounds to one Frobenius bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: The Kronecker delta: delta_ij is 1 if i=j and 0 otherwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the right-hand side of the equations defining Q^T Q = I.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: gamma_k(lambda,u) = exp((lambda*sqrt(k)*u + k*u^2)/(1-u)) - 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: With k=m, it appears in both the local-control bounds and the final coefficient c6*lambda*sqrt(n)*gamma_m(lambda,u).

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the natural number 1+1 is at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides typeclass evidence for interpreting the numeral 2 in polymorphic arithmetic; it adds no mathematical hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of run returning its column-indexed random local perturbation matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These matrices are the objects controlled by hlocal and used in the execution recurrence underlying the assumed columnwise result.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of a stochastic model returning its operation-indexed computed-value functions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The execution package requires each entry of RHat to equal one such computed value.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: The projection of a stochastic model returning its natural-number operation count.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It determines the finite index type for modeled operations and for the output index assigned to each RHat entry.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a vector v, the matrix with entries delta_ij - v_i v_j, namely I-vv^T.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the unperturbed transformation in each step of the execution recurrence.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: For each error e_k and every function g of the preceding errors, whenever the relevant functions are integrable, integral(g(previous errors)*e_k) equals integral(g(previous errors))*integral(e_k).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an internal stochastic-model assumption expressing a precise expectation-factorization property. It does not add a separate clause to the final existential conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: For an m-by-n matrix B and real L, the quantified operator bound ||Bx||_2 <= L||x||_2 for every real n-vector x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the local perturbation bounds contained in hlocal.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a finite real vector x, sqrt(sum_i x_i^2), its Euclidean norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures vectors in local operator bounds and columns in the assumed columnwise perturbation bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary matrix-vector multiplication: (Bx)_i = sum_j B_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the Euclidean norm, it defines the operator bounds used by the local-control package.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: For operation k and outcome omega, the vector consisting of errors with indices strictly before k.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It specifies exactly which previous errors may be supplied to the test function g in the model's factorization condition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that an index lying below k.val also lies below the total number of steps when k is a valid step index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It validates the finite indices used to form the previous-error vector and has no independent mathematical content in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It requires all measurability, Big-O, probability, structural, factorization, and norm-bound clauses to hold simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: DFunLike.coe
dependency_coverage.meaning: The coercion that evaluates a function-like object at an argument.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits the probability measure to be evaluated on the good event.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The extended nonnegative real numbers, represented as nonnegative reals with a top element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Measure values, including the probability of the good event, initially lie in this type.

dependency_coverage.name: ENNReal.toReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: The map from an extended nonnegative real to a real obtained through its nonnegative-real component.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It converts the measure of the good event to the real number compared with 1-2mn exp(-lambda^2). The model's total mass one guarantees finiteness here.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses the exact matrix factorization and the equations defining orthogonality and triangular structure.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It introduces, in order, a good event, a random square matrix Q, a random perturbation DeltaA, and a remainder depending on u and omega.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul

dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched strict order.

dependency_coverage.name: MeasurableSpace

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Matrix entries, lambda, unit roundoff, norms, probabilities after conversion, coefficients, and remainders are real-valued.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary multiplication on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every scalar product in coefficients, sums, matrix operations, and model equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real additive identity 0.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets positivity conditions, zero matrix entries, and the limit point in the Big-O condition.

dependency_coverage.name: Set

dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The first existential witness is a set of outcomes in Omega.

dependency_coverage.name: Set.instMembership
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard membership instance for predicate-defined sets.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the usual interpretation of omega belonging to the good event.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: The instance interpreting the numeral 0 from a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real zero used in 0<lambda and related expressions without adding an assumption.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-addition instance induced by an ordinary addition operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HAdd notation to pointwise matrix addition or ordinary real and natural addition.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-multiplication instance induced by an ordinary multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes HMul notation to ordinary real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the meanings of 0<c5, 0<c6, finite-index bounds, and the below-diagonal test j<i.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The instance interpreting each natural literal as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural literals used in positivity, indexing, and powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Asymptotics.IsBigO
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm-based asymptotic relation f = O(g) along a specified filter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applied at the neighborhood filter of 0 with g(u)=u^2, it defines the required quadratic-order remainder.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite enumeration structure on Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes all sums over matrix and vector indices finite and exhaustive.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: The underlying natural-number value of a finite index.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used to compare row and column positions and to select errors preceding a given operation.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Finite summation in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean and Frobenius norms, matrix products, orthogonality equations, and the execution transformations.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes each sum range over all valid rows, columns, or inner-product indices.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched exponentiation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies squares of entries, lambda, and u in norms, probability bounds, and coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched subtraction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms 1-2mn exp(-lambda^2), 1-u, exp(...) - 1, and I-vv^T.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The natural-exponent power operation induced by a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets real squares such as lambda^2, u^2, and matrix-entry squares.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical cast of a natural number into a type with natural-number casts.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns c6, m, and n into reals in probability and perturbation coefficients.

dependency_coverage.name: Neg.neg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Typeclass-dispatched unary negation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms the exponent -lambda^2 in the probability threshold.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: The instance interpreting the numeral 1 from a type's multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies real and extended-nonnegative-real ones in formulas and probability normalization.

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The uniform-space structure inherited from a pseudometric space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates in giving the reals their standard topology for the neighborhood-based Big-O statement.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.exp
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real exponential function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in both the probability threshold exp(-lambda^2) and gamma_m(lambda,u).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It permits finite real sums used in norms, products, and orthogonality.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies natural powers of real quantities.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The canonical embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets m, n, c5, c6, and numerical constants as real scalars where required.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNeg
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary negation on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets -lambda^2 and real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative identity 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the probability threshold, denominator 1-u, and exponential correction exp(...) - 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real subtraction, defined as addition of the negative.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets all real differences occurring in the explicit constants.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.norm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm on a real number, equal to its absolute value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the norm used by the Big-O relation, so the remainder comparison is in absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard pseudometric structure on the reals with distance |x-y|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It induces the ordinary real topology used for convergence as u tends to zero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines Euclidean and Frobenius norms and the factors sqrt(m) and sqrt(n).

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The topological-space structure inherited from a uniform space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides the standard real neighborhood filter used in the Big-O condition.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Decidable equality for finite indices, implemented by comparing their natural values.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It allows the Kronecker delta to choose between 1 and 0 according to whether two indices are equal.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous-power instance induced by an existing power operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes power notation to natural powers of real numbers.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The homogeneous-subtraction instance induced by an ordinary subtraction operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes subtraction notation to ordinary real subtraction.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatAtLeastTwo
dependency_coverage.meaning: An instance interpreting a numeral n in a type with natural casts when n is certified to be at least two.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports polymorphic occurrences of numerical constants such as 2 without imposing an additional target hypothesis.

dependency_coverage.name: nhds
dependency_coverage.meaning: The neighborhood filter of a point in a topological space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: nhds 0 specifies that each remainder is O(u^2) as the real variable u approaches zero.

dependency_coverage.name: AddCommMonoidWithOne.toAddMonoidWithOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-monoid-with-one structure inherited from an additive commutative monoid with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is typeclass infrastructure for numerical constants in extended nonnegative-real measure expressions.

dependency_coverage.name: AddMonoidWithOne.toOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative-one structure projected from an additive monoid with one.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the value 1 used to normalize the model's measure.

dependency_coverage.name: DecidableEq
dependency_coverage.meaning: A procedure deciding equality for every pair of elements of a type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required to define the finite-index Kronecker delta used in Q^T Q = I.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division operation projected from a division-inverse monoid.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.instOfNat

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.last

dependency_coverage.name: MeasureTheory.Integrable

binders: An arbitrary type Omega equipped with a measurable-space structure.
Natural-number dimensions m and n and an arbitrary real m-by-n matrix A, indexed by Fin m and Fin n.
A stochastic arithmetic model containing a probability measure P, operation data, and unit roundoff u.
An execution package run for A in that model, with final random computed matrix RHat(omega).
Natural numbers c5 and c6 and a real number lambda.
A local-control package hlocal and a columnwise backward-error package indexed by hlocal.
hypotheses: The model has P(Omega)=1, unit roundoff 0<=u<1, and operation errors satisfying computedValue=exactValue*(1+error), |error|<=u, measurability, integrability, zero mean, and the stated expectation-factorization condition against functions of previous errors.

The execution package entails n<=m and n>0. It has states X_0=A and X_{j+1}=(I-v_jv_j^T+E_j)X_j, with sum_i v_j(i)^2=2, final state RHat=X_n, each RHat entry equal to a modeled computed value, and RHat upper trapezoidal.
The local-control package supplies a measurable probability-one event on which, equivalently, every local perturbation E_j satisfies ||E_j x||_2 <= c5*gamma_m(lambda,u)*||x||_2 for all x.

The columnwise package supplies a measurable event, random Q and DeltaA, and per-column pointwise O(u^2) remainders, with eventwise Q^TQ=I, A+DeltaA=Q RHat, and the corresponding Euclidean bound for every column.
conclusions: There exists a measurable set E of outcomes.
There exist functions Q: Omega -> R^(m by m), DeltaA: Omega -> R^(m by n), and r: R x Omega -> R.
For every fixed omega, r(u,omega)=O(u^2) as u tends to 0.
The real-valued probability satisfies toReal(P(E)) >= 1-2mn exp(-lambda^2).
For every omega in E, RHat(omega) is upper trapezoidal: RHat_ij(omega)=0 whenever j<i.
For every omega in E, Q(omega)^T Q(omega)=I_m.
For every omega in E, the exact pointwise matrix equality A+DeltaA(omega)=Q(omega)RHat(omega) holds.
For every omega in E, ||DeltaA(omega)||_F <= c6*lambda*sqrt(n)*(exp((lambda*sqrt(m)*u+m*u^2)/(1-u))-1)*||A||_F + r(u,omega), where u is the model's unit roundoff.
mathematical_definitions: Fin d indexes the natural numbers 0,...,d-1.
For a vector x, ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_i x_i^2).
For an m-by-n matrix B, ||B||_F = sqrt(sum_i sum_j B_ij^2).
delta_ij is 1 if i=j and 0 otherwise; Q^TQ=I means sum_k Q_ki Q_kj=delta_ij for every i,j.
Matrix multiplication is (QR)_ij=sum_k Q_ik R_kj, and matrix addition is entrywise.
The probability threshold is p(lambda,m,n)=1-2mn exp(-lambda^2).
The leading normwise coefficient is c6*lambda*sqrt(n)*gamma_m(lambda,u).
The condition r(u,omega)=O(u^2) is taken as u approaches 0 in the usual two-sided real topology and is asserted separately for each omega.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every measurable outcome space, every real m-by-n matrix A, every stochastic model and compatible execution, every positive natural constants c5 and c6, every positive real lambda, and every supplied local and columnwise control package, there are a measurable good event E, a random m-by-m matrix Q, a random m-by-n perturbation DeltaA, and a real remainder r(u,omega) such that each fixed-outcome remainder is O(u^2) near u=0, the probability of E is at least 1-2mn exp(-lambda^2), and on E the computed matrix RHat is upper trapezoidal, Q has orthonormal columns, A+DeltaA=Q RHat exactly, and the Frobenius perturbation obeys ||DeltaA||_F <= c6*lambda*sqrt(n)*(exp((lambda*sqrt(m)*u+m*u^2)/(1-u))-1)*||A||_F+r(u,omega), evaluated at the model's unit roundoff u.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: Although m and n are universally quantified natural numbers, an execution package can be constructed only with n>0 and n<=m. Thus the proposition is vacuous for dimensions for which no run exists; in particular a run cannot exist when n=0 or n>m.
The theorem is conditional on inhabitants of the local-control and columnwise package types. If either package is unavailable, the corresponding universal implication is vacuous.
The probability lower bound can be nonpositive when 2mn exp(-lambda^2)>=1, in which case that bound alone is trivial.
No restriction beyond lambda>0 is imposed on lambda, and no numerical relationship among c5, c6, lambda, m, and n is required.
The unit roundoff restriction 0<=u<1 is encoded inside the model rather than as an explicit target binder hypothesis; it makes the denominator 1-u positive.
The Big-O assertion is pointwise in omega. Its constants and neighborhood may depend on omega; no uniform-in-omega O(u^2) estimate is stated.
The final inequality adds r(u,omega) itself, not |r(u,omega)|, and the proposition does not explicitly require r to be nonnegative.
Only the good event is required to be measurable. No measurability is asserted for Q, DeltaA, or r.
Orthogonality, factorization, and the normwise perturbation bound are required only on E. No corresponding bound or factorization is asserted outside E.
The execution package already encodes that RHat is upper trapezoidal for every omega, even though the explicit target conclusion repeats this property only for omega in E.
The equality A+DeltaA=Q RHat is exact and entrywise, but the proposition states no forward-error, residual, solution-accuracy, uniqueness, or optimality claim.
The stochastic assumptions encode the displayed expectation-factorization property for each error against functions of prior errors; no stronger unstated notion of independence is asserted.
The model probability is converted from an extended nonnegative real to a real in the event bound. Its total mass-one condition ensures the relevant measure values are finite.
